name: robots/6-robot__wpr_simulation
title: WPR Gazebo mobile-robot simulation
intro: WPR Gazebo mobile-robot simulation, adapted from 6-robot/wpr_simulation. It reads `read_odometry` and `read_pose_diff`; runs `publish_cmd_vel` and `resume_simulation`. `publish_cmd_vel`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist velocity setpoint on /cmd_vel. The WPRPlugin callback stores the components, also while the world is paused; the receipt is transmission evidence and the values sent, not motion or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
